{"consolidated_memory":"## Crash Loop Issues in infra/k8s/deployment.yaml

This file has experienced two distinct crash loop incidents in the deployment, both presenting the same symptom (container restarting seconds after start) but with different root causes and fixes.

### INCIDENT 1: Off-by-One Slice Bound (2026-03-18)
- **File**: infra/k8s/deployment.yaml
- **Problem**: Crash loop in deployment
- **Signal**: Container restarting a few seconds after start, manifested only after client had already retried once
- **Root Cause**: Off-by-one error in slice bound
- **Fix**: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- **PR**: #4535 on branch fix/crash-loop-1
- **Measured Result**: 76 duplicate rows per day stopped being written
- **Repro Method**: Roll out to small node pool
- **Stack/Language**: YAML
- **Covering Check**: Manifest lint and dry run in CI

### INCIDENT 2: Connection Pool Exhaustion Under Burst Load (2026-04-14)
- **File**: infra/k8s/deployment.yaml (same area as Incident 1)
- **Problem**: Crash loop in deployment
- **Signal**: Container restarting a few seconds after start
- **Trigger**: Two requests racing on the same key
- **Root Cause**: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- **Fix**: Raised pool ceiling and added a bounded wait queue in front of it
- **PR**: #4561 on branch fix/crash-loop-2
- **Measured Result**: Alert stayed quiet for 29 consecutive days
- **Repro Method**: Roll out to small node pool

**Context**: Both incidents affected the same infrastructure component and shared context from earlier deployment work, but required different fixes targeting distinct failure modes."}
